places.getThere: Fly to Cam Ranh then about 1 h by car; train to Thap Cham station; or a bus from Saigon in about 6 h.

days.title: 藩朗 – 波克朗加莱塔
days.morning: Arrive in Phan Rang (about 1 hour from Cam Ranh airport, or by train to Thap Cham station) and eat bánh căn.
days.afternoon: Po Klong Garai Cham towers on Trau Hill at sunset.
days.evening: Grilled lamb and a stroll on Ninh Chu beach.

days.title: 永熙湾
days.morning: Follow the coastal road through Nui Chua to Vinh Hy Bay and take a glass-bottom boat over the coral.
days.afternoon: Swim, snorkel and eat seafood on a floating raft.
days.evening: Sunset from the coastal pass, then back to Ninh Chu.

days.title: 水獭洞 – 葡萄园
days.morning: Hang Rai early in the morning: coral rocks covered in green moss.
days.afternoon: Thai An vineyards – cut grapes and taste wine and grape syrup.
days.evening: Raw anchovy salad and grilled snails in Ninh Chu.

days.title: 南强沙丘 – 占族村落
days.morning: Nam Cuong sand dunes at sunrise.
days.afternoon: Bau Truc pottery village – pots shaped by hand without a wheel.
days.evening: Squid pancakes and jellyfish noodles in Phan Rang.

days.title: 盐田 – 返程
days.morning: Tri Hai salt fields and seaside wind turbines.
days.afternoon: Buy raisins, grape syrup and Phan Rang garlic to take home.
days.evening: Head to Cam Ranh airport or Thap Cham station.
